whatsNew.en-AU:
This update explains what is needed when a collection can't be set up for TaskNotes, and offers Try again, instead of stopping on the setup screen.

It also keeps a task deletion going if you switch away during the undo window, highlights dates and other recognised phrases more accurately while you type a new task, and shows all seven days in the date picker on wider screens.

reviewNotes:
TaskNotes 1.0.11 update

HOW TO REVIEW
TaskNotes needs an mdbase account. We have provided a review account in the App Review sign-in information. Its sample collection already contains tasks.
1. Open TaskNotes and start the mdbase sign-in flow.
2. An mdbase sign-in page opens in a browser sheet. Sign in with the review account, choose the collection "[test] C hosted tasks", and approve TaskNotes.
3. You return to TaskNotes with that collection open.

WHAT CHANGED
- When a collection can't be set up, TaskNotes explains why and offers Try again instead of stopping on the setup screen.
- App settings are stored in the collection's TaskNotes settings record.
- A pending task deletion now completes after the app returns from the background.
- Quick-add highlights recognised dates and phrases more accurately.
- The date picker shows all seven weekday columns on wider screens.
There are no new permissions, no new data collection and no in-app purchases. Screenshots are still representative.

WHAT THE APP DOES
TaskNotes is a task manager that stores tasks as portable Markdown records. Users can capture, edit, complete, search, assign and reorder tasks; set dates, priorities, repeats, reminders and time estimates; use lists, boards and calendars; attach images; and turn Scratchpad notes into tasks.

SERVICES USED
mdbase stores the user's collection and schedules reminders. Firebase Cloud Messaging and Apple Push Notification service deliver reminder notifications only after the user opts in. The notifications carry no task content.
